_source: A read-only mailbox search on 2026-09-08 for journal table-of-contents alerts over the previous 400 days.
_finding: Only the University of Chicago Press sends table-of-contents alerts, and only for three journals. The other 24 journals on the shelf send nothing at all - a new issue is discovered about a new issue only by opening the bookmark.
_titles_note: Titles marked "prefix": true came from the Gmail list snippet and are cut off mid-sentence; the dashboard matches them by prefix. The rest were read from the full message body.
